## Change summary

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome. Do not claim "production-ready", "fixed", "verified", or "GO" without linked evidence.

## Validation evidence

- [ ] Clean dependency install completed
- [ ] Production build completed
- [ ] Unit/component tests passed
- [ ] Route-contract/static validators passed
- [ ] Playwright/browser regression passed
- [ ] Accessibility checks passed or exceptions documented
- [ ] Security/dependency checks passed where applicable
- [ ] Generated deployment artifact inspected where applicable

Evidence links:

- Workflow run(s):
- Artifact ID/digest:
- Screenshots or manual browser evidence:
- Live-route evidence (post-deployment only):

## Content and source review

- [ ] Changed Tamil text received appropriate human review where required
- [ ] English meaning/transliteration reviewed where changed
- [ ] Deity, temple, scripture, history, governance, timing, price, condition, and support-link claims use approved evidence states
- [ ] "Verified" and "Needs Review" labels are evidence-based
- [ ] Rights/provenance for new media is recorded
- [ ] Generated guidance is not presented as scripture or primary-source evidence

## Deployment and rollback

- [ ] No secrets or environment-specific credentials are committed
- [ ] Deployment is scoped to the intended environment
- [ ] Health/release and direct-route checks are defined
- [ ] PWA/cache behavior is preserved or deliberately versioned
- [ ] Rollback trigger and exact rollback action are documented
- [ ] Post-deployment smoke-test owner is identified

## Manual acceptance required

List checks that cannot be automated, including real-device/browser, visual, Tamil editorial, cultural, DNS, certificate, or third-party platform validation.
